releaseNotes: v8.10.24: Core performance optimizations and UI polish. Fixed cleanNovelProse reference error and replaced DOM textarea decoder with high-speed zero-DOM parser; replaced 500k-array allocation wordCount with zero-allocation char scanner; throttled AppLogger live logs with requestAnimationFrame; memoized library search filtering; guarded Moon+ Reader scroll auto-advance against short chapters and added previous/next chapter navigation bar; integrated Android MediaSession for TTS lock-screen/headphone controls; added safe-area insets for Android gesture bar; enabled 1-tap direct reading from Library for all books.
